chunks.arabic_text: الكَافِي: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارِ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: اطْلُبُوا الْعِلْمَ وَتَزَيَّنُوا مَعَهُ بِالْحِلْمِ وَالْوَقَارِ، وَتَوَاضَعُوا لِمَنْ تُعَلِّمُونَهُ الْعِلْمَ، وَتَوَاضَعُوا لِمَنْ طَلَبْتُمْ مِنْهُ الْعِلْمَ، وَلَا تَكُونُوا عُلَمَاءَ جَبَّارِينَ فَيَذْهَبَ بَاطِلُكُمْ بِحَقِّكُمْ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Seek knowledge and adorn yourselves with it through forbearance and dignity, and humble yourselves to those to whom you teach knowledge, and humble yourselves to those from whom you seek knowledge, and do not be tyrannical scholars so that your falsehood drives away your truth.

en.summary: The Imam instructs seekers of knowledge to adorn themselves with moral virtues like forbearance and dignity. He emphasizes humility both when teaching and when learning, warning that arrogance among scholars can cause their truth to be rejected by falsehood.
en.seo_question: What are the ethical attributes of a true scholar according to Shia hadith?
